name: Fuse Naoki
source:
Naoki is the captain of the kendo club. He is also an otaku with a tendency to dig up the secrets of everyone around him.

When he's first introduced, Naoki is simply a guy that's more than willing to extort favors from others while making money by selling pictures of the girls to anyone interested.

Despite his tendency to joke around, Naoki is very serious when it comes to friendship and his duty to those he cares about. This is mostly seen in the type of relationship he has with [url=/c983]Akira[/url], as he has vowed to look after her back when they were children.

Unlike [url=/c978]Tooru[/url], Naoki is more decisive when it comes down to it, and less willing to go with the flow.

[From [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/26776.html]Moroboshi Yuumei's review[/url].]
